blocks.text:
In the morning, transfer to Guatemala City airport for your flight to Flores, Petén.

Flores, the capital of El Petén, was built on a small island in Lake Petén Itzá and is connected by a half-kilometer bridge to the town of Santa Elena on the shore. During the Maya period, the site of Flores was the capital of the imperial province of Tayasal, which was completely destroyed.

During the colonial period, the city was unknown until Tikal was discovered, with the most convenient route from the east passing through Flores.

This small, picturesque town, with its colorful government buildings and church surrounding the main square, is famous for the Actun Kan or La Cueva de la Sapiente caves, the charming villages of San Andrés and San José, the ruins from the Classic Maya period in Motul, and the scenic views of Lake Petén Itzá.

In the morning, you will have a guided tour through the trails and main plazas of the most important city of the Maya world. Here, you will notice how nature and archaeology beautifully combine. You’ll be able to see rich wildlife, the Maya forest, millennia-old temples that stand as silent witnesses to the birth, grandeur, and eventual decline of one of the oldest civilizations on the planet, all during our trip to Tikal, the City of Voices.
